item.title: Ex-Jets linebacker Darron Lee arrested, charged in girlfriend’s murder
item.description: Former New York Jets linebacker Darron Lee has been arrested and charged in connection with the brutal murder of his girlfriend.

item.title: Rex Ryan’s son Seth is Jets new passing game coordinator
item.description: Another member of the Ryan family will join Gang Green's coaching staff.

item.title: 7 injured in fire at swanky Brooklyn cigar lounge
item.description: Around 79 firefighters and EMS medics rushed to Blew Smoke around 2:37 a.m. near Washington Ave. and Pacific St. in Prospect Heights where the fire broke out on the first floor of the three-story building.

item.title: Accused Ohio child predator charged with threatening to kill JD Vance
item.description: A 33-year-old Ohio man is charged with threatening to kill Vice President Vance and trafficking in child pornography materials.

item.title: Green Day slams ICE, Trump and Epstein in pre-Super Bowl show
item.description: Green Day didn't mince words during a pre-Super Bowl performance, calling out ICE agents, the Trump administration and even changing lyrics to reference Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: As NYC temps plunge near zero, Mamdani adds even more warming sites, outreach for homeless
item.description: Sixty-five warming spaces — located at hospitals, houses of worship and schools — are active around town throughout the weekend, with warming buses also parked outside many of the hospitals and also transit hubs.

item.title: NYPD releases photo of gunman wanted in deadly Brooklyn lounge shoot-out
item.description: Saturday evening, police released a photo of Haile Cummings, 34, who is being sought in connection with the furious gun battle inside Taste of the City Lounge on Franklin Ave. in Crown Heights on Aug. 17.

item.title: Sheet metal, debris fall from Con Ed rooftop in Manhattan amid high winds
item.description: First responders rushed to the scene where debris fell from the structure around 3:50 p.m. near 12th Ave. and W. 58th St. in Hell's Kitchen.
